reveal.text: Operational signals show a system's health or behavior. Common signals include metrics, logs, events, traces, and audit activity.
Use metrics for trends, logs for application failures, CloudTrail for API activity, and events for state changes.
CloudWatch can show high CPU, logs can show `DB_TIMEOUT`, and CloudTrail can show who changed a security group.

reveal.text: A CloudWatch alarm evaluates a metric or metric-math expression over one or more periods. Its state can be OK, ALARM, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

A HighErrorRate alarm can publish to SNS; a composite alarm can require multiple alarms before paging.

      Threshold: 10

description: Stop an instance and snapshot a specified EBS volume
parameters:
  InstanceId:
    type: String
  VolumeId:
    type: String
mainSteps:

prompts.label: WHAT ARE S3 TRANSFER AND LIFECYCLE STRATEGIES?

reveal.text: Amazon S3 is object storage. Transfer strategy depends on object size, client location, path, and lifecycle.
Use multipart upload for large objects and Transfer Acceleration for suitable long-distance uploads. Use DataSync for bulk or scheduled movement; use lifecycle rules to transition or expire objects.
A 200-GB upload favors multipart upload; a scheduled 40-TB NFS migration to S3 favors DataSync.

prompts.label: DON'T CONFUSE THESE

V9 fact-reviewed: current official-document factual audit applied after the coverage, concrete-example, and ADHD/readability passes. Known factual errors, ambiguous service behavior, outdated service limits, and incomplete configuration examples were corrected.

Domain 1 progressive-text rewrite: all 98 text reveals were shortened into low-friction retrieval prompts with one hidden key phrase normally and no more than two. Surrounding context intentionally makes the hidden information reasonably guessable. Non-text reveals and curriculum structure are unchanged.

Domain 1 progressive-text review: all 98 text reveals are short low-friction retrieval prompts with one hidden key phrase normally and no more than two. Hidden phrases are capped at six words and reveal text at 32 words. Surrounding context intentionally makes the answer reasonably guessable. Factual wording was rechecked against current AWS documentation; non-text reveals and curriculum structure are unchanged.

Glossary migration: glossary terms are now scoped per knowledge node/page instead of globally across the domain. Each page includes only supporting terms actually present in its learner-facing content. The page main topic is not added merely because it is the node title. This avoids irrelevant highlights and context collisions such as treating the words Recovery Point inside RPO as an AWS Backup recovery-point term.
